project(VisionCameraFaceDetector)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.9.0)

set(PACKAGE_NAME VisionCameraFaceDetector)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)

add_library(${PACKAGE_NAME} SHARED src/main/cpp/cpp-adapter.cpp)

# Nitrogen generated C++ bindings (generated by `npx nitrogen`)
include(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../nitrogen/generated/android/VisionCameraFaceDetector+autolinking.cmake)

include_directories(
  "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../../react-native-vision-camera/android/build/headers/visioncamera"
  "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../node_modules/react-native-vision-camera/android/build/headers/visioncamera"
  "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../example/node_modules/react-native-vision-camera/android/build/headers/visioncamera"
)

find_package(react-native-vision-camera REQUIRED CONFIG)

target_link_libraries(
  ${PACKAGE_NAME}
  react-native-vision-camera::VisionCamera
)
